description: This file defines a mock implementation of a Thermostat Cluster for testing purposes. It includes attributes, enums for system modes and control sequences, and methods to get and set thermostat-related attributes.

classes.name: MockThermostatCluster
classes.description: A mock implementation of a Thermostat Cluster for testing, with attributes to simulate thermostat behavior and control.

methods.name: getAttributeData
methods.description: Retrieves data for specified attributes based on internal state.

methods.name: setAttributeData
methods.description: Sets attribute data based on received payload, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: setHeatSetpoint
methods.description: Updates the heat setpoint and reports the change.

methods.name: setCoolSetpoint
methods.description: Updates the cool setpoint and reports the change.

methods.name: setSystemMode
methods.description: Updates the system mode and reports the change.

methods.name: setHoldOn
methods.description: Sets whether hold is active and reports the change.
